style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, full-bleed vertical
motion_rule: HE is the subject of every window and crosses the frame edge to edge, talking windows too, always SIDEWAYS, never up or down; ONE action per window, only one of them moving; from 7.2 he stays in the chair and the camera sweeps sideways past him edge to edge; new shot size every window
character: a palm-sized tarsier, grey-brown fur, ENORMOUS round amber eyes, a loose office tie, reckless
second_characters: ONE grey hamster teller in cashier sleeves, a brass scoop in his paws, never speaking
props: ONE huge glass jar packed with coins; loose coins; ONE brass scoop; his office tie; ONE striped deck chair; ONE straw hat; ONE pair of sunglasses; ONE gold coin
prop_continuity: the crack runs longer every window, hairline at 0.0, burst at 5.55; the jar gone by 7.2; the tie stays on him all clip; the chair, hat, sunglasses and gold coin appear only from 7.2 and are his; speech is only heard, never shown
environment: a sunlit marble bank hall; from 6.4 the marble turns to white sand, a turquoise sea and a thatched bungalow behind him

audio.language: Russian, verbatim, nothing added or repeated; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: high squeaky male voice, reckless and merry, even 4.5 syllables per second
audio.pronunciation: za-CHEM, ko-PIT, ved ZHIZN, mi-mo-LYOT-nyy, po-TRAT, um-RI, BYS-tro
audio.pacing: speech 0.45-1.8 and 2.65-5.55; one pause 1.8-2.65; voiceless after 5.55, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: coins pouring, glass creaking, the jar bursting, surf and gulls from 6.4

HE rams the jar belly and drives left to right, the crack running longer

no words. THE HAMSTER strides edge to edge and dumps a scoop of coins onto HIM
HE bursts out of the coin heap and tears left to right, coins spraying at the lens
HE rams the crack with both feet and slings himself right to left
HE drives left to right along the glass, his tie whipping

no words. The jar bursts and HE surges left to right on the coin flood past the lens

must_appear: the crack growing every window, the jar bursting at 5.55, the coin flood edge to edge, the marble turning to sand, him in the deck chair with the sea and bungalow behind him, the hat and sunglasses on his own face, his wink, the gold coin leaving his thumb and flaring
